newsitem.title: UK: Largest fast ferry in UK waters enters service.
newsitem.headline: Largest fast ferry in UK waters enters service.

text.p: The largest single-hulled fast ferry operating in UK waters made its inaugural crossing between Dover and Calais today after a 24 hour delay, Hoverspeed said Wednesday.
The company, which is a division of Sea Containers Ltd, said the SuperSeaCat departed at 7 a.m. this morning for the 50-minute crossing to France.

The ferry was delayed from entering service on Tuesday because Hoverspeed was waiting for the Italian minister of transport to sign a permit to operate as flag state authority for the vessel, a spokesman for the company said.

Hoverspeed said the vessel, which can carry 800 passengers and 175 cars, will give the company the highest sailing frequency, with up to 22 return departures a day, on the short sea crossings this summer. - Paul Berrill Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
